easyPrerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
